description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5995013000593 CABLE ASSEMBLY,RADI: Line 0001 Qty 5 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0073 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
